title: Skills
description: All 18 skills: trainers, the Guardian Stone that speeds them up, skill books, quest bonuses and the fastest ways to level. Trainers go up to 90 (max 5 lessons per level); the rest comes from practice. Flat bonuses — challenges, quest rewards, skill books sold by merchants — are worth more once a skill is high and levels slowly.

items.title: One-handed
items.description: Damage with one-handed swords, war axes, maces and daggers. Perks add damage, bleeding, staggering and dual-wield power attacks.

facts.label: Master trainer
facts.value: Chief Burguk — Dushnikh Yal (you must be Blood-Kin)

facts.label: Expert trainer
facts.value: Athis — Jorrvaskr, Whiterun (Companions only)

facts.label: Guardian Stone
facts.value: The Warrior Stone (+20% skill gain)

facts.label: Skill books
facts.value: 5 books; e.g. "Fire and Darkness" — Ratway Warrens (Riften), in Esbern's room

facts.label: Quest bonus
facts.value: Find Amren's family sword (Whiterun) — +1 One-handed and Block; "The Ghost of Old Hroldan" — +1 One-handed and Block; "The Path of Might" in the Oghma Infinium (quest "Discerning the Transmundane") — +5 to all warrior skills

tips: XP depends on the weapon's base damage and the number of hits, not on perks, enchantments or sharpening — hit fast and often.
Power attacks give no extra XP per hit, so quick normal swings are better.
Handy training dummies: your own summons (e.g. from Conjure Flame Atronach) and horkers, which are slow and have lots of health.
Athis is a follower: after a lesson you can take your gold back from his inventory via the trade menu.

items.title: Two-handed
items.description: Damage with greatswords, battleaxes and warhammers. Perks boost damage, bleeding, staggering and sweeping power attacks.

facts.label: Master trainer
facts.value: Vilkas — Jorrvaskr, Whiterun (Companions only); also Fura Bloodmouth (Castle Volkihar, Dawnguard) and Wulf Wild-Blood (Skaal Village, Dragonborn)

facts.label: Expert trainer
facts.value: Torbjorn Shatter-Shield — House of Clan Shatter-Shield, Windhelm

facts.label: Guardian Stone
facts.value: The Warrior Stone (+20% skill gain)

facts.label: Skill books
facts.value: 5 books; e.g. "Song of Hrormir" — Jorrvaskr Living Quarters (Whiterun)

facts.label: Quest bonus
facts.value: "A Few Words with You" (Octieve San, Solitude) — +1 Two-handed; "Rjorn's Drum" (Giraud Gemane, Bards College) — +1 to all warrior skills; "The Path of Might" in the Oghma Infinium (quest "Discerning the Transmundane") — +5 to all warrior skills

tips: XP is based on base weapon damage: use the weapon with the best damage per second (battleaxes, later Daedric or Dragonbone).
Sharpening, perks and enchantments add no XP and even slow you down, since enemies die in fewer hits.
The Elemental Fury shout speeds up your swings, and with them your skill gains.
Vilkas is a follower: you can take the training gold back from his inventory.

items.title: Archery
items.description: Damage with bows and crossbows (crossbows come with Dawnguard). Perks add zoom with slowed time, stagger, criticals and faster draw.

facts.label: Master trainer
facts.value: Niruin — The Ragged Flagon – Cistern, Riften (Thieves Guild only); also Sorine Jurard (Fort Dawnguard, Dawnguard)

facts.label: Expert trainer
facts.value: Aela the Huntress — Jorrvaskr, Whiterun (Companions only)

facts.label: Guardian Stone
facts.value: The Thief Stone (+20%) — not the Warrior Stone, even though the skill sits in the Warrior tree

facts.label: Skill books
facts.value: 5 books; e.g. "The Black Arrow, v2" — The Drunken Huntsman (Whiterun), under the counter

facts.label: Quest bonus
facts.value: Angi's archery challenges at Angi's Camp near Falkreath — +6 in total; "Rjorn's Drum" (Giraud Gemane, Bards College) — +1 to all warrior skills; "The Path of Might" in the Oghma Infinium (quest "Discerning the Transmundane") — +5 to all warrior skills

tips: Don't rush to Angi (Angi's Camp, in the mountains southeast of Falkreath): her challenges give a flat +6, and at high skill every point takes the longest to earn. Come when Archery is around 90 and finish it to 100 with the challenges, skill books and quest rewards.
XP depends on the bow's base damage and on hitting, not on full draw, arrows, perks or sharpening — frequent shots with a fast bow pay off.
Shoot durable targets that don't run away: your summons, horkers, giants from a safe distance.
Faendal (Riverwood) and Aela are followers: you can take the training gold back from their inventory.
items.missable: If you are rude to Angi when you first meet her, she attacks — her challenges and the +6 Archery are lost.

items.title: Block
items.description: Defending with a shield or weapon: less damage taken while blocking, shield bashes, deflecting arrows and spells, staggering counters.

facts.label: Master trainer
facts.value: Chief Larak — Mor Khazgur (you must be Blood-Kin)

facts.label: Expert trainer
facts.value: Njada Stonearm — Jorrvaskr, Whiterun (Companions only)

facts.label: Guardian Stone
facts.value: The Warrior Stone (+20% skill gain)

facts.label: Skill books
facts.value: 5 books; e.g. "Death Blow of Abernanit" — Hall of the Dead catacombs, Whiterun

facts.label: Quest bonus
facts.value: Amren's family sword and "The Ghost of Old Hroldan" — +1 each; Find Roggi Knot-Beard's ancestral shield (Kynesgrove) — +1; "Rjorn's Drum" (Giraud Gemane, Bards College) — +1 to all warrior skills; "The Path of Might" in the Oghma Infinium (quest "Discerning the Transmundane") — +5 to all warrior skills

tips: XP comes from damage blocked, so block hits from strong enemies — a shield gives twice as much XP as a weapon.
A shield bash gives five times the XP of a weapon bash, but costs a lot of stamina.
Train it together with armor: stand in front of a weak enemy and heal with Healing — Block, Restoration and armor all grow.
Against mages, the Spellbreaker shield lets you block spells.

items.title: Heavy Armor
items.description: Effectiveness of iron, steel, Dwarven, ebony, Daedric and dragonplate armor. Perks remove weight, boost full-set protection and reflect damage.

facts.label: Master trainer
facts.value: Farkas — Jorrvaskr, Whiterun (Companions only); also Isran (Fort Dawnguard, Dawnguard) and Kuvar (Thirsk Mead Hall, Dragonborn)

facts.label: Expert trainer
facts.value: Gharol — Dushnikh Yal (you must be Blood-Kin)

facts.label: Guardian Stone
facts.value: The Warrior Stone (+20% skill gain)

facts.label: Skill books
facts.value: 5 books; e.g. "Hallgerd's Tale" — Jorrvaskr (Whiterun), main hall

facts.label: Quest bonus
facts.value: "Rjorn's Drum" (Giraud Gemane, Bards College) — +1 to all warrior skills; "The Path of Might" in the Oghma Infinium (quest "Discerning the Transmundane") — +5 to all warrior skills

tips: XP comes from the strength of incoming hits, not from your armor rating — good armor does not slow your progress.
Wear a full set: the more heavy pieces you wear, the more XP per hit. A mixed set only trains one armor skill.
Let a weak enemy (a mudcrab, say) hit you while you heal — Restoration and Block grow too.
Farkas is a follower: you can take the training gold back from his inventory.

items.title: Smithing
items.description: Forging weapons and armor and improving them at grindstones and workbenches. Perks unlock new materials and double improvement bonuses.

facts.label: Master trainer
facts.value: Eorlund Gray-Mane — the Skyforge, Whiterun (Companions only); also Gunmar (Fort Dawnguard, Dawnguard)

facts.label: Expert trainer
facts.value: Balimund — Riften, outside The Scorched Hammer

facts.label: Guardian Stone
facts.value: The Warrior Stone (+20% skill gain)

facts.label: Skill books
facts.value: 5 books; e.g. "The Armorer's Challenge" — the Skyforge (Whiterun), on the slab

facts.label: Quest bonus
facts.value: Bring Ghorza gra-Bagol (Markarth) the book "Last Scabbard of Akrash" — +1; "Rjorn's Drum" (Giraud Gemane, Bards College) — +1 to all warrior skills; "The Path of Might" in the Oghma Infinium (quest "Discerning the Transmundane") — +5 to all warrior skills

facts.label: Good to know
facts.value: The quest "Unfathomable Depths" (Riften) grants Ancient Knowledge: without unofficial patches it acts as +15% when improving items and +25% armor rating

tips: The classic: iron daggers — one iron ingot and one leather strip each; later you can enchant and sell them for profit.
Leather bracers give the most XP per piece of leather — hides from hunting are free.
Improving at a grindstone or workbench also trains the skill (in proportion to the value added), but smelting and tanning do not.
Activate the Warrior Stone and sleep in a bed before a big crafting session — XP comes noticeably faster.

items.title: Destruction
items.description: Offensive fire, frost and shock magic. Perks reduce spell cost, strengthen elements and add dual-cast impact.

facts.label: Master trainer
facts.value: Faralda — College of Winterhold (members only)

facts.label: Expert trainer
facts.value: Sybille Stentor — the Blue Palace, Solitude

facts.label: Guardian Stone
facts.value: The Mage Stone (+20% skill gain)

facts.label: Skill books
facts.value: 5 books; e.g. "Mystery of Talara, v3" — Birna's Oddments (Winterhold), upstairs

facts.label: Quest bonus
facts.value: "Pantea's Flute" (Pantea Ateia, Bards College) — +1 to all mage skills; "The Path of Magic" in the Oghma Infinium (quest "Discerning the Transmundane") — +5 to all mage skills

tips: XP depends on the spell's base cost, not its damage, and only counts when it hits a target that takes damage.
The only skill where difficulty cuts XP: on Legendary you get 75% less; it peaks at Adept and below.
Dual casting gives no extra XP — cast one-handed.
Runes (Fire Rune) give XP for every enemy they hit — place them in the path of a group.

items.title: Restoration
items.description: Healing, wards against magic and anti-undead spells. Perks boost healing, add magicka regeneration and a last-chance heal.

facts.label: Master trainer
facts.value: Danica Pure-Spring — Temple of Kynareth, Whiterun (after "The Blessings of Nature"); also Florentius Baenius (Fort Dawnguard, Dawnguard)

facts.label: Expert trainer
facts.value: Colette Marence — College of Winterhold (members only); Keeper Carcette — Hall of the Vigilant

facts.label: Guardian Stone
facts.value: The Mage Stone (+20% skill gain)

facts.label: Skill books
facts.value: 5 books; e.g. "Withershins" — Temple of Kynareth (Whiterun)

facts.label: Quest bonus
facts.value: "Pantea's Flute" (Pantea Ateia, Bards College) — +1 to all mage skills; "The Path of Magic" in the Oghma Infinium (quest "Discerning the Transmundane") — +5 to all mage skills

tips: Healing only trains the skill when it restores health you actually lost: heal while a weak enemy (a mudcrab, a wolf) hits you.
Higher-level spells give more XP: switch from Healing to Fast Healing as soon as you can.
Lesser Ward raised in short bursts while fighting mages trains the skill quickly up to 65.
Heal a wounded follower with Heal Other during fights — they last longer and the skill grows.
items.missable: With Dawnguard, vampires destroy the Hall of the Vigilant once you reach level 10 — expert trainer Keeper Carcette dies (Colette Marence remains).

items.title: Alteration
items.description: Magic that changes the world: magical armor, light, paralysis, detect life, ore transmutation. Perks add spell absorption and magic resistance.

facts.label: Master trainer
facts.value: Tolfdir — College of Winterhold (members only)

facts.label: Expert trainer
facts.value: Dravynea the Stoneweaver — Kynesgrove

facts.label: Guardian Stone
facts.value: The Mage Stone (+20% skill gain)

facts.label: Skill books
facts.value: 5 books; e.g. "Breathing Water" — Kraldar's House (Winterhold), in a basket by the fireplace

facts.label: Quest bonus
facts.value: "Dravynea's Frost Salts" (Kynesgrove) — +1; "Pantea's Flute" (Pantea Ateia, Bards College) — +1 to all mage skills; "The Path of Magic" in the Oghma Infinium (quest "Discerning the Transmundane") — +5 to all mage skills

tips: Cast Oakflesh, later Stoneflesh, at the start of every fight and keep renewing it — it only gives XP with enemies around.
Magelight can be cast anywhere while travelling: you get XP as long as the orb hits a surface.
Transmute Mineral Ore turns iron ore into silver and silver into gold — XP and money at once.
Higher-level spells give more XP; Fortify Alteration gear reduces their cost.

items.title: Conjuration
items.description: Summoning atronachs, daedra and bound weapons, raising the dead and soul trapping. Perks allow two summons and make them stronger.

facts.label: Master trainer
facts.value: Falion — Morthal, his house; also Talvas Fathryon (Tel Mithryn, Dragonborn)

facts.label: Expert trainer
facts.value: Phinis Gestor — College of Winterhold (members only)

facts.label: Guardian Stone
facts.value: The Mage Stone (+20% skill gain)

facts.label: Skill books
facts.value: 5 books; e.g. "The Doors of Oblivion" — Fellglow Keep, on a podium

facts.label: Quest bonus
facts.value: "Pantea's Flute" (Pantea Ateia, Bards College) — +1 to all mage skills; "The Path of Magic" in the Oghma Infinium (quest "Discerning the Transmundane") — +5 to all mage skills

tips: Fastest method: near an enemy (a mudcrab is ideal), cast Bound Sword and cancel right after the cast sound — repeat.
A summon gives XP if it meets an enemy before it expires: cast Conjure Flame Atronach before every fight.
Cast Soul Trap on every enemy — XP plus filled soul gems for Enchanting.
Banishing your own summons also gives XP.

items.title: Illusion
items.description: Mind magic: calm, fear, frenzy, courage, invisibility and silent steps. Perks let it work on stronger enemies.

facts.label: Master trainer
facts.value: Drevis Neloren — College of Winterhold (members only)

facts.label: Expert trainer
facts.value: Atub — Largashbur (after "The Cursed Tribe")

facts.label: Guardian Stone
facts.value: The Mage Stone (+20% skill gain)

facts.label: Skill books
facts.value: 5 books; e.g. "The Black Arts On Trial" — The White Phial (Windhelm), under the counter

facts.label: Quest bonus
facts.value: "Kill the Vampire" (Sybille Stentor, Solitude) — +1; "Pantea's Flute" (Pantea Ateia, Bards College) — +1 to all mage skills; "The Path of Magic" in the Oghma Infinium (quest "Discerning the Transmundane") — +5 to all mage skills

tips: Muffle can be cast on yourself again and again anywhere — it gives XP even without enemies.
Courage and Rally on townsfolk are not crimes: cast them in crowded places — every target hit gives XP.
In combat, use Calm and fear spells on enemies — higher-level spells give more XP.

items.title: Enchanting
items.description: Learning enchantments by disenchanting items, applying them to weapons and armor, and recharging weapons with soul gems. Perks strengthen enchantments and allow a second effect.

facts.label: Master trainer
facts.value: Hamal — Temple of Dibella, Markarth (after "The Heart of Dibella"); also Neloth (Tel Mithryn, Dragonborn)

facts.label: Expert trainer
facts.value: Sergius Turrianus — College of Winterhold (members only)

facts.label: Guardian Stone
facts.value: The Mage Stone (+20% skill gain)

facts.label: Skill books
facts.value: 5 books; e.g. "Enchanter's Primer" — Carlotta Valentia's House (Whiterun)

facts.label: Quest bonus
facts.value: "Pantea's Flute" (Pantea Ateia, Bards College) — +1 to all mage skills; "The Path of Magic" in the Oghma Infinium (quest "Discerning the Transmundane") — +5 to all mage skills

tips: Enchanting gives the same XP regardless of soul gem size or effect — use the cheapest petty soul gems.
Enchant cheap items — such as iron daggers you forged — and sell them: that also trains Speech.
Disenchant every item with a new enchantment: it unlocks the effect and gives solid XP (apparel usually more than weapons).
Fill gems with Soul Trap on small creatures; recharging weapons also gives a little XP.

items.title: Light Armor
items.description: Effectiveness of hide, leather, Elven, glass and dragonscale armor. Perks remove weight, boost full-set protection and add a dodge chance.

facts.label: Master trainer
facts.value: Nazir — Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary (members only)

facts.label: Expert trainer
facts.value: Grelka — Riften market by day, stays at Haelga's Bunkhouse at night

facts.label: Guardian Stone
facts.value: The Thief Stone (+20% skill gain)

facts.label: Skill books
facts.value: 5 books; e.g. "The Refugees" — Solitude Blacksmith, on an upstairs shelf

facts.label: Quest bonus
facts.value: Find Shahvee's Amulet of Zenithar (Windhelm) — +1 Light Armor and Lockpicking; "Finn's Lute" (Inge Six Fingers, Bards College) — +1 to all thief skills; "The Path of Shadow" in the Oghma Infinium (quest "Discerning the Transmundane") — +5 to all thief skills

tips: XP comes from the strength of incoming hits, and the more light armor pieces you wear, the more you get — wear a full set.
A high armor rating does not slow progress: improve your armor freely.
Stand in front of a weak enemy and heal yourself — Restoration and Block grow at the same time.
Light armor builds take fewer hits, so the skill grows slower than Heavy Armor — top it up with trainers and books.

items.title: Sneak
items.description: Staying unseen and landing sneak attacks with damage multipliers. Perks add silent steps, a silent roll and huge dagger sneak damage.

facts.label: Master trainer
facts.value: Delvin Mallory — The Ragged Flagon, Riften

facts.label: Expert trainer
facts.value: Garvey — Markarth, the Warrens

facts.label: Guardian Stone
facts.value: The Thief Stone (+20% skill gain)

facts.label: Skill books
facts.value: 5 books; e.g. "The Red Kitchen Reader" — New Gnisis Cornerclub (Windhelm), under the stairs

facts.label: Quest bonus
facts.value: "Finn's Lute" (Inge Six Fingers, Bards College) — +1 to all thief skills; "The Path of Shadow" in the Oghma Infinium (quest "Discerning the Transmundane") — +5 to all thief skills

tips: Successful sneak attacks give the most XP — melee ones 12 times more than ranged; damage doesn't matter.
A well-known trick: sneak attack your own horse with an iron dagger and heal it with Heal Other.
Good dummies: a summoned Dremora Lord (appears facing away from you) and sleeping enemies.
Simply moving in sneak mode near NPCs slowly trains the skill too — especially near enemies and shopkeepers.

items.title: Lockpicking
items.description: Picking locks from Novice to Master. Perks widen the sweet spot, find more gold and grant unbreakable lockpicks.

facts.label: Master trainer
facts.value: Vex — The Ragged Flagon, Riften (Thieves Guild membership not required)

facts.label: Expert trainer
facts.value: Ma'jhad — Ma'dran's Khajiit caravan (travels between Solitude and Windhelm)

facts.label: Guardian Stone
facts.value: The Thief Stone (+20% skill gain)

facts.label: Skill books
facts.value: 5 books; e.g. "Advances in Lockpicking" — The Ragged Flagon – Cistern, training room

facts.label: Quest bonus
facts.value: Find Shahvee's Amulet of Zenithar (Windhelm) — +1 Lockpicking and Light Armor; "Finn's Lute" (Inge Six Fingers, Bards College) — +1 to all thief skills; "The Path of Shadow" in the Oghma Infinium (quest "Discerning the Transmundane") — +5 to all thief skills

tips: Pick every lock instead of looking for keys: harder locks give more XP.
Each lock gives XP only once — re-picking the chests in the Thieves Guild training room gives nothing.
A broken lockpick also gives a little XP, so stock up on lockpicks from merchants.

items.title: Pickpocket
items.description: Stealing from pockets and planting items. Chance depends on the item's weight, XP on its value. Perks let you steal equipped gear.

facts.label: Master trainer
facts.value: Vipir the Fleet — Thieves Guild, The Ragged Flagon (members only)

facts.label: Expert trainer
facts.value: Silda the Unseen — Windhelm, outside Candlehearth Hall or the blacksmith

facts.label: Guardian Stone
facts.value: The Thief Stone (+20% skill gain)

facts.label: Skill books
facts.value: 5 books; e.g. "Beggar" — Haelga's Bunkhouse (Riften), upstairs

facts.label: Quest bonus
facts.value: "Finn's Lute" (Inge Six Fingers, Bards College) — +1 to all thief skills; "The Path of Shadow" in the Oghma Infinium (quest "Discerning the Transmundane") — +5 to all thief skills

tips: Steal light, valuable things — gems and jewelry: high success chance and lots of XP.
Reverse pickpocketing: plant gold or an item on an NPC and steal it back — XP at no real cost.
Pay a trainer for a lesson in any skill, then steal the gold back — free training plus Pickpocket XP.
The skill rises very fast and drives your character level up — don't overdo it at low levels.

items.title: Speech
items.description: Merchant prices plus persuasion, intimidation and bribe checks in dialogue. Perks let you sell anything to any merchant and invest in shops.

facts.label: Master trainer
facts.value: Giraud Gemane — Bards College, Solitude

facts.label: Expert trainer
facts.value: Ogmund the Skald — Markarth; also Ronthil (Castle Volkihar, Dawnguard)

facts.label: Guardian Stone
facts.value: The Thief Stone (+20% skill gain)

facts.label: Skill books
facts.value: 5 books; e.g. "The Buying Game" — Bards College (Solitude), classroom

facts.label: Quest bonus
facts.value: Bring Ysolda (Whiterun) a mammoth tusk — +1; Jump off Bard's Leap Summit (the Reach) — the ghost Azzadal gives +2; "The Path of Shadow" in the Oghma Infinium (quest "Discerning the Transmundane") — +5 to all thief skills

tips: XP comes from the value of the item traded, not the price — sell expensive things.
Sell items one at a time: a stack of identical items gives XP as if it were one.
Sell everything you craft: forged gear, enchanted items, potions.
Use the Persuade, Intimidate and Bribe options in dialogue — successful checks also train the skill.

items.title: Alchemy
items.description: Brewing potions and poisons from ingredients at an alchemy lab. Perks make them stronger and reveal ingredient effects when eaten.

facts.label: Master trainer
facts.value: Babette — Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary (members only)

facts.label: Expert trainer
facts.value: Arcadia — Arcadia's Cauldron, Whiterun; also Milore Ienth (Raven Rock, Dragonborn)

facts.label: Guardian Stone
facts.value: The Thief Stone (+20% skill gain)

facts.label: Skill books
facts.value: 5 books; e.g. "Herbalist's Guide to Skyrim" — Arcadia's Cauldron (Whiterun), back room

facts.label: Quest bonus
facts.value: Bring Lami (Morthal) the book "Song of the Alchemists" — +1; Find the Ring of Pure Mixtures for Frida (Dawnstar) — +1; "Finn's Lute" (Inge Six Fingers, Bards College) — +1 to all thief skills; "The Path of Shadow" in the Oghma Infinium (quest "Discerning the Transmundane") — +5 to all thief skills

tips: XP is proportional to the potion's value — brew the most expensive ones you can.
Blue Mountain Flower + Wheat make a potion with two health effects; adding Giant's Toe makes one of the most valuable potions in the game.
Buy every cheap ingredient from apothecaries and mix whatever combines — new combinations give XP even when they fail.
Sell potions one at a time — Speech grows too.
